correctAnswer: Switch to enoxaparin 1 mg/kg (80 mg) subcutaneously every 12 hours
explanation: Recurrent VTE despite adherent, therapeutic warfarin: CHEST 2021 suggests switching to LMWH at least temporarily. Enoxaparin treatment dose is 1 mg/kg SC q12h (FDA label). Alteplase is wrong: this PE is normotensive without RV strain, and CHEST recommends against systemic thrombolysis for PE without hypotension. Switching to a DOAC such as apixaban is a reasonable-sounding option, but CHEST suggests LMWH for VKA failure; DOACs lack evidence in this setting. Takeaway: breakthrough VTE on therapeutic VKA -> switch to LMWH; reserve lysis for hypotensive (high-risk) PE.
